description.value:
A people living in the land of Spira, tall and thinly built. Guados are most known for their connections to the forces of death and the afterlife.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Guados gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Constitution.
  • Type: Guados are Humanoids with the guado subtype.
  • Size: Guados are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Guados have a base speed of 35 feet.
  • Languages: Guados begin play speaking Common and Guado. Guados with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Al Bhed, Draconic, Elvaan, Lalafell, Numish, Ronsaur, or Vieran.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Deathless Spirit: Guados gain Shadow Resistance 5, do not lose hit points from negative levels, and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, and necromancy/dark spells.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Skill Bonuses: Guados gain a +2 racial bonus to Bluff and Sense Motive skills.
  • Skill Training: Guados always treat Knowledge (Planes) and Knowledge (Religion) as class skills.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Detect Undead (Sp): Guados can use detect undead as a constant spell-like ability.
  • Elemental Summoner: Increase the duration of summon spells for the chosen elemental subtype by 2 rounds.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Moderate Fleetness: Guados gain a +5 foot bonus to their base land speed.
